description: Migrate from Python FastAPI backend to TypeScript Hono backend with pnpm monorepo structure

userStories.title: Initialize pnpm monorepo at project root
userStories.description: As a developer, I need pnpm monorepo infrastructure to share code between frontend and backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Run pnpm init at project root
Create tsconfig.base.json with shared TypeScript settings (target ES2022, strict mode)

userStories.title: Create packages/shared package with extracted types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared types package so frontend and backend can share type definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/shared/ directory structure with src/types/ and src/schemas/

Export types and schemas from package index
